verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents workflow-level delete operations (delete workflows) and dedicated VPC deployment for 'full data isolation,' plus GDPR compliance claims, which imply some data-handling control, but there is no explicit documentation of user-controlled data retention periods or a mechanism to delete ingested/processed source data itself. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy/settings, explicit 'delete my data' API or UI control, independent confirmation of GDPR deletion rights being exercisable by users.
